contract: Meta Trio v2 assessment contract (js/schema.js; FIRST_RESPONSE.md section 4). Assessment categories are the medicus categories in js/products.js.
ground_truth_note: Current-taxonomy set: the frozen 20 scenarios (MED-001..020) plus one scenario per EMS scene-type category the js/products.js taxonomy grew on 2026-10-31 (MED-021..027). Labels in this file were authored before any assessment source was run against them. The harness reads this file read-only and never mutates it. A scenario's ground_truth_label is the visible scene a reviewer would record from the described scene; alert_expected is true when the scene warrants an EMS scene alert under the current taxonomy. 'normal activity' never warrants an alert; 'indeterminate' never warrants an alert on its own. No label here is a diagnosis, a cause, a severity call, or a triage decision: labels describe only what is visible.
